otp_sent: A verification code has been sent to the registered email address. Codes received within their validity period remain usable.
passkey_email_hint: To sign in with a Passkey, enter the registered email address or leave it blank for passwordless sign-in.
bind_hint: Connect to the address below using Minecraft Java Edition. The login service provides a one-time binding code on first connection. Run /link in-game to obtain subsequent codes.
bind_hint_no_address: Connect to this server using Minecraft Java Edition. The login service provides a one-time binding code on first connection. Run /link in-game to obtain subsequent codes.
no_owner_title: Owner account not initialized; sign-in unavailable
no_owner_subtitle: Owner is the platform owner account
no_owner_intro: The Owner sign-in method has not been initialized. The host administrator must complete the following setup. Minecraft startup is not required.
no_owner_step_setup: Run this command on the host to finish deployment and configure panel access:
no_owner_step_link: Open the one-time setup link provided by the terminal in a browser, register an email address, and create a Passkey. A Minecraft profile can be linked from Account.
no_owner_still_unbound: No initialized Owner account was detected. Confirm that the terminal generated a setup link and that account initialization is complete.
op_methods_hint: Staff should sign in with a passkey. An account without a passkey can sign in with an email code below, and each such sign-in sends a security notice to the account email; or choose Operator sign-in, approved in game by an admin with a linked Minecraft account.
op_hint: Staff only: a code is emailed to you, and an online operator must approve the request in-game before you can sign in.
op_approve_hint: A verification code has been sent to the registered email address. Codes received within their validity period remain usable. An online administrator must approve this request in-game:
op_approved: Request approved. Enter the verification code from the email.
op_expired: This request expired before it was used. Request a new one to sign in.
op_poll_retrying: Unable to connect to Felis. Polling will continue at a reduced frequency.
setup_invalid_subtitle: The setup link is invalid or has already been used
setup_invalid_hint_suffix: on the server to get a fresh setup link, or head to the sign-in page.
setup_failed_subtitle: The server could not complete sign-in. The setup link remains valid. Retry the operation.
setup_email_desc: Mail delivery is not configured yet, so the address is only recorded. Once mail is configured and the address verified, it can receive sign-in codes and alerts.
setup_passkey_desc: Create a passkey using a fingerprint, facial recognition or device PIN to sign in to the console. A passkey is required to complete initialization; browsers create passkeys only under a trusted certificate.
setup_passkey_refused: The browser did not create a passkey. If you did not cancel it, the usual cause is an untrusted certificate: the installer uses a self-signed one by default, and browsers do not allow passkeys on such a page. Configure mail delivery with sudo felis setup on the server and verify your email instead, or open the panel at an address with a trusted certificate (a reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel).
setup_passkey_desc_optional: Create a passkey using a fingerprint, facial recognition or device PIN to sign in to the console. Browsers create passkeys only under a trusted certificate.
setup_passkey_refused_mail: The browser did not create a passkey. If you did not cancel it, the usual cause is an untrusted certificate: the installer uses a self-signed one by default, and browsers do not allow passkeys on such a page. Verify your email with a code instead.
setup_passkey_refused_nano: The browser did not create a passkey. If you did not cancel it, the usual cause is an untrusted certificate: the installer uses a self-signed one by default, and browsers do not allow passkeys on such a page. Add an [smtp] section to /etc/felis/felis.toml on the server, restart felis-nano and reopen this page to verify your email instead, or open the panel at an address with a trusted certificate (a reverse proxy).
setup_use_email: Verify your email with a code instead
setup_verify_desc: The console sends a 6-digit code to this address. Verifying it completes initialization; afterwards the address receives sign-in codes, alerts and account notices.
session_ended_notice: The sign-in session has expired or been revoked. Sign in again to return to the originally requested page.
setup_game_optional: The management panel is available after sign-in setup is complete. A Minecraft profile can be linked later from Account.
